name: DreamShaper (SD1.5 - Artwork)

name: RealVis (SDXL - Photography)
note: Civitai permissions: images and generation services allowed, selling the model not allowed, credit required.

name: ZavyChroma (SDXL - Artwork)
license: CreativeML Open RAIL++-M + creator commercial-license terms
note: Base license is Open RAIL++-M, but the creator requires a paid commercial license for generation services other than Civitai and for companies (explicitly incl. photo/video editing apps); only artists selling prints are exempt. No derivatives. The misri HF re-host says 'unknown'.

name: Nova Anime XL (Illustrious - Anime)
note: Civitai IL v12.5 (sha256 matches); Civitai's license for Illustrious-based models. Creator rules add: generated images may not be used commercially unless edited; selling the model not allowed. Acly re-host repo label (creativeml-openrail-m) does not match.

name: NoobAI XL (Illustrious - Anime)

note: NoobAI terms: 'We prohibit any form of commercialization ... of the model, derivative models, or model-generated products.' Civitai permissions only allow Civitai generation.
